name: axiom-declines
description: Remembers a permission request you declined and stops Claude Code asking for the same thing again. Stores salted token hashes, never the command or its arguments.

threshold.title: Match threshold
threshold.description: How alike two requests must be (0.3 to 1) to count as the same. Lower holds more, and risks holding unrelated requests.

expire_days.title: Days a decline holds
expire_days.description: A decline stops holding after this many days. 0 turns holding off; declines are still saved.

ask_before_scheduling.title: Ask before scheduling
ask_before_scheduling.description: Claude Code schedules session tasks (CronCreate) without asking. Turn this on to get a permission prompt first, so you have something to decline.
